name: BASDAI score
seoTitle: BASDAI score Calculator: Free, With Steps
seoDesc: BASDAI score: a free health calculator that walks you through 7 values, with the formula spelled out and a worked example.
summary: The BASDAI score calculator takes the numbers you enter and reports BASDAI score immediately. It is free to use, needs no account, and shows the working rather than just the answer. Think of it as a shortcut for an informed starting point to take to a clinician, not a diagnosis. Press Calculate for the answer; change a value and it steps off screen until you press again, so each edit can be judged on its own.

sections.title: How does the BASDAI score calculator work?
sections.html:
The BASDAI score calculator takes the values in the form, applies the relationship described below and reports BASDAI score in the results panel.

Working from the top of the form: you choose the option that describes your case (the AS neck, back or hip pain, the pain/swelling in joints and the discomfort from any areas tender to touch or pressure).

Press Calculate and the page works through the equation with the values you supplied and derives the rest; it then keeps up with you as you correct a typo.

sections.title: The formula behind the BASDAI score calculator
sections.html:
One relationship drives the whole page:

BASDAI score=((1 ÷ 5) × fatigue ÷ tiredness + (1 ÷ 5) × AS neck, back or hip pain + (1 ÷ 5) × pain ÷ swelling in joints + (1 ÷ 5) × discomfort from any areas tender to touch or pressure + (1 ÷ 10) × morning stiffness + (1 ÷ 10) × morning stiffness duration)

Read it as an ordinary equation. Where a word appears instead of a letter, it is the label of one of the boxes in the form; where a function appears, it is the usual mathematical meaning of that function.

sections.title: What does the result mean?
sections.html:
• A number, filled in as soon as the inputs allow it.

Before doubting the arithmetic, check the inputs: a unit chip on the wrong setting, a drop-down left at its default, or a percentage typed as a whole number rather than a decimal will each shift the answer by a clean power of ten.

sections.title: When should you use it?
sections.html:
The BASDAI score calculator earns its place in the middle of a task, not instead of one. It is most useful when:

  • Preparing for an appointment so you can describe your numbers clearly
  • Deciding whether a reading is worth a second look
  • Tracking a measurement over time and understanding what changed

sections.title: How do you get a reliable answer?
sections.html:
• Compare two scenarios by changing the input that actually differs between them, and keep the rest fixed, so the difference you see is the difference you meant to test.
  • Keep the units you enter consistent. Mixing centimetres into a field that expects metres is the single most common way to get an answer that is out by a factor of a hundred.
  • Leave the field you want solved for empty rather than guessing at it. Filling every box tells the calculator you already know the answer.
  • Change one input at a time when you are exploring. Two simultaneous changes make it impossible to tell which one moved the result.

sections.title: What else is worth knowing?
sections.html:
• Answers that depend on a drop-down reflect the option you picked, not a range. Switching to a neighbouring option is the quickest way to see how much that factor matters.
  • Some options are backed by reference tables that ship with the page, so the values are fixed data rather than a live lookup.

sections.title: What are the limits worth knowing?
sections.html:
Every tool draws a boundary somewhere. For the BASDAI score calculator, these are the ones that matter:

  • The 6 drop-downs on this page offer a fixed list of cases. A value that is not on the list cannot be entered, and the nearest option is not always a good substitute.
  • The calculator reports what the relationship implies; it does not judge whether the inputs themselves are sensible, so a figure that is out by a factor of ten will produce an answer that is out by the same factor.

faq.q: What does the BASDAI score calculator work out?
faq.a: It returns BASDAI score. Every field in the form feeds the same relationship: press Calculate once and changing any of them updates the result immediately, with no page reload.

faq.q: What do I need to enter to use the BASDAI score calculator?
faq.a: The form asks for a few values, which is 6 fields in total. Each one is labelled with what it means and, where relevant, the unit it expects. Anything you leave blank is treated as the value to solve for.

faq.q: How much do the drop-down choices change the answer?
faq.a: There are several choices to make (6 in total), and each one selects a different case rather than scaling the result. Switching a single option and watching the result is the fastest way to see how much that choice is worth.

With the values the page starts from, the calculator reports BASDAI score = 0. Treat that as a reference point rather than a recommendation: it exists so you can tell at a glance whether your own inputs are on the same scale.

faq.q: Is the BASDAI score calculator free to use?
faq.a: Yes — no account, no sign-up and no limit on how many times you run it. The arithmetic happens in your browser, so the values you type are not sent anywhere.

faq.q: Do I have to fill in every box?
faq.a: Fill in the ones you know. The result boxes are computed from them, so you never enter a value the formula can derive — press Calculate and every result updates together.
